note: The estate genome-spider walks by default. `root` is resolved relative to spider.mjs's own directory (spiders/species/genome-spider/), not to the current working directory, so this file works the same whether you run it from the repo root or from inside genome-spider/. Override with --root=<path> or the GENOME_SPIDER_ROOT env var to point at a different checkout layout (this is how spiders.yml's CI job uses it — see spiders/.github/workflows/genome.yml).
